notes: Checked by hand only. I have not run the plan checker; the done-check is that bun tools/plan/cli.ts exits 0. Stop spacing: T1 is 308 then 310 m. T2 is about 330, 331.5 and 321 m. S1 is 255 then 245 m. Every platform (30 m tram, 50 m sky) is on straight track or beam. T2/sunset's platform ends about 3 m short of the Sunset Way fillet.

Reach (N-R1), worst cases: crown-terraces is 247.1 m from S1/gardens and crescent-north is 247 m from S1/circus. Both are under the 250 m limit, but only just. crescent-east is 198.6 m from T2/harbour. rocket-west and lantern-west are only in reach through T2/sunset (109 m and 161 m).

Interchange pairs: T1/circus to S1/circus is 119 m, T1/records to T2/market 55 m, and T2/harbour to S1/harbour 33.5 m. All are within the 150 m limit, so the three lines form one network (S-I1, N-C1).

For Datum, via Aster: there is no Skyport station. On the S1 trunk, the 200 m minimum from Harbour puts it at x 540 or beyond, and that is all water up to the loop at x 708, so no one can walk to it. Once the plan has walkable public space in that stretch that joins Crown Parade or Harbour Road, I will place the station there. I have not moved any plan geometry.

For Aster, on T2's status: the concept [cfba…] calls Crown Circus the one interchange and ends T1 on the circus loop. Datum's T2 adds two more interchanges, Records/Market Street and Harbour, so whether T2 is accepted needs Sky's decision. If T2 is dropped, rocket-west fails reach (273 m from T1/records), T1/records loses its interchange, and I place the stops again.

S1/harbour at (340,0) stands on the quay pier (x 330 to 385). Its entrance opens onto the quay walk beside Harbour Road. S1/gardens is over Circus Road's median, with its entrance at the north end of Garden Walk on the Records Axis (x −160).

Handoffs. Waymark: T2/sunset and T2/market sit on Market Street outside the Records Precinct gates, so police could seal them as stations. Pulse: the biggest transfer crowd will be at Boulevard × Market Street, between T1/records and T2/market.
